steps.summary: Twelve rendered font sizes and four weights became a five-size ladder with two weights, so the page reads as one system and headings are found by size, not boldness.

changes.what: Font sizes on the page, collapsed onto a ladder of named roles
Font weights in use
changes.after: 2 weights (400, 500); webfont request cut from 4 weights to 2

changes.what: Headline figures stop shouting over their labels
The page title becomes the last step of the breadcrumb in the header bar
changes.before: 22px / 600 h1 under a 12.5px breadcrumb, two lines

changes.what: Section headings one rank up, carried by size and tracking rather than weight
Sidebar group labels in sentence case over a hairline
changes.after: Analytics — 12px / 400 / sentence case / 0, hairline rule beneath

changes.what: Page paths set in the text face instead of a monospace
A metric-matched fallback so the font swap doesn't move text
changes.after: "Inter Fallback": Arial at size-adjust 107.12%, ascent 90.44%, descent 22.52%

steps.summary: The greys were re-derived from measured contrast, and colour now marks only what needs a person: red for the three real problems, indigo for links, focus and the chart.

changes.what: Timestamps, captions, axis labels and placeholders became readable
changes.after: #656970 — 5.51:1 on the page, 4.83:1 on its worst surface

changes.what: The search field and toolbar buttons get an edge you can see
The current nav item is marked by a neutral pill and weight, not the brand colour
changes.before: indigo text on an indigo tint (5.70:1)
changes.after: ink at 500 on a grey pill (14.29:1), with aria-current

changes.what: Rising figures stop being green; only the conversion drop stays red
changes.before: 3 green chips at 3.93:1, 1 red chip at 4.54:1
changes.after: 3 neutral chips at 7.67:1, 1 red chip at 5.21:1

changes.what: Routine feed events lose their colour; only the bounce alert keeps red
changes.before: 4 coloured event icons (green, indigo, red, grey)

changes.what: The previous-period line can be seen
The 61.3% bounce rate no longer relies on colour alone
changes.after: a red chip with an alert glyph and screen-reader text

changes.what: Greys tinted less, and the dark page lifted off near-black
changes.before: neutral chroma 0.03–0.038; dark page OKLCH L 0.159
changes.after: chroma ≤ 0.012; dark page L 0.18, raised L 0.22

steps.summary: A mosaic of nine boxes became stacked sections on the page beside an activity rail, with a stat strip on top and one framed table.

changes.what: Headline metrics as one strip parted by hairlines instead of four tiles
Chart, table and activity sit on the page instead of in cards
Activity becomes a rail beside the content, parted by a hairline
changes.before: a 360px card in a two-column card grid
changes.after: a 340px rail with a 0.5px left rule

changes.what: A shorter header bar
Radii collapsed onto a ladder
Spacing that groups: heading closer to its content than to the section above
Every count, delta and flag shares one chip shape
Breakpoints on the content panel, and a z-index ladder
changes.after: 3 breakpoints (2 container queries); z 10 / 20 / 50 / 60 / 100 as tokens; skip link added

steps.summary: Surfaces now say what they do: the header is opaque, buttons are flat, and only menus, the tooltip and the mobile sheet lift off the page.

changes.what: The sticky header is opaque instead of a frosted blur
changes.after: opaque page colour, hairline edge, a small raised shadow

changes.what: Buttons and fields sit flat
Menus and the tooltip get a ring edge and one shared shadow
changes.after: 0.5px ring + contact layer + 10% ambient; real border under high contrast

changes.what: Floating surfaces lift in dark mode by getting lighter
changes.before: menu the same colour as cards (#12151c)
changes.after: menu one step lighter (#21242a, L 0.26) than raised (L 0.22)

changes.what: Feed paths lose their little boxes
changes.before: bordered, tinted path tokens inside sentences

steps.summary: Durations now follow how much of the screen changes, on one curve, and reduced motion swaps slides for fades instead of switching everything off.

changes.what: Hover colour on rows and nav is quicker
The date menu and tooltip open on one curve and leave faster
changes.before: menu 140ms ease-out; tooltip 120ms in and out
changes.after: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) in; tooltip out at 100ms ease-in

changes.what: The mobile nav sheet opens and closes asymmetrically
changes.after: 200ms in on the standard curve, 130ms out on ease-in

changes.what: The search field's focus edge appears instantly
Reduced motion substitutes instead of subtracting
changes.before: 1 global rule: transition and animation none !important
changes.after: 3 component branches: menu fades, sheet fades in place, chevron flips

changes.what: Durations and curves as tokens

steps.summary: Small promise-keeping fixes: links name where they go, and direction, alerts and unread notifications are spoken to screen readers, not only drawn.

changes.what: The activity link names its destination
Delta direction is announced, not only drawn as an arrow
The notification button says there is something unread
